notes: Batch 04 is 15 rows, all for one national sorority, Delta Phi Epsilon International Sorority, whose headquarters is 251 S Camac Street in Philadelphia. The IRS rows are chapters or filers of that one group, so all 15 are hidden as private. Membership runs through campus recruitment, legacy, or alumnae initiation, and the site lists no public meetings, open events, or chapter contacts a newcomer could use. The chapter locator names Philadelphia area campus chapters (Drexel, Temple, La Salle, Saint Joseph's, Thomas Jefferson) but no Philadelphia alumnae association, and one web search found none either. Two rows (Epsilon Phi, Epsilon Zeta) share Greek letters with Philadelphia area campus chapters on the locator; that is unconfirmed, so no link was made. Status is unknown for every row: the national site shows 2026 items (International Governing Board 2026, academic year 2026 scholarship recipients), but none ties to a particular chapter. The batch liveness check on the Alpha Eta row (alive, sitemap, 2026-10) agrees with my check of the national site. Policy question for the owner: campus sorority chapters open to students through recruitment are hidden here under the private rule. If you want campus chapters listed as student organizations, that is a call for you to make. Process: one WebSearch used of 2; six WebFetch calls used (home page, sitemap index, events sitemap, page sitemap, chapter locator, how to join). One early call went to a Docs tool by mistake; it was refused and nothing was written. The IRS contact name is left out because it is a private individual. Stopped after one pass because all 15 rows are the same organization and none is joinable by a newcomer; no budget left unused that would change a verdict.
